Ceam Amadeo S.p.A : The engineering of Invisibility, since 1962
The story of CEAM began in 1962, sparked by the entrepreneurial intuition of

In that first workshop—born from the transformation of a rural space into a mechanical atelier—more than just the first metal component was forged; it was the very identity of a company destined to become a pillar of Lombardy’s world-renowned furniture district.

What began as an enterprising artisanal curiosity has evolved, decade after decade, into an industrial excellence capable of anticipating international market trends, specializing in solutions that seamlessly fuse aesthetics with precision engineering.

Today, led by the second generation—through the dynamic vision of Marina and the analytical rigor of Davide—CEAM Amadeo SpA represents the perfect synthesis of respect for tradition and a drive toward the avant-garde.

for architecture firms and high-end furniture brands. Our approach is not that of a mere supplier, but of a technical consultant capable of engaging with designers to solve the dimensional and functional challenges of contemporary design.
Technological Innovation: From the S.T.A.R.S. System to Series 14

The heartbeat of our production is constant innovation. In the early 2000s, the introduction of the S.T.A.R.S. (Sistema a Tre Assi Regolabili Singolarmente) series redefined industry standards, allowing for millimeter-perfect calibration and the total disappearance of hardware.
Beginning in 2016, this evolutionary drive embarked on a new path of internationalization. Thanks to the strategic contribution of global partners, we have refined our flagship range, giving life to

This line of concealed hinges, now featuring 12 models and available in 15 refined finishes, represents the ultimate synthesis of engineering precision and aesthetic research. It is the definitive technical response for projects where the detail marks the difference between a piece of furniture and a work of art.

value that, for us, is synonymous with total traceability, superior quality, and distinctive design. With a consolidated presence across five continents, we export not just products, but a technical culture that celebrates extreme reliability and functional elegance.

“We design and manufacture premium concealed hinges and metal components, merging Italian craftsmanship with industrial innovation. Our commitment is to provide architects and luxury manufacturers with reliable, versatile, and advanced solutions, ensuring bespoke technical support that transforms every design challenge into a flawless execution.”

“To render technology invisible, letting pure design take center stage. We aim to be the global benchmark in opening system engineering, where mechanical excellence vanishes to exalt the beauty of contemporary architecture.”
